basics.name: Milad Mohammadi
basics.label: Senior AI Engineer & LLM Researcher
basics.summary: Senior AI Engineer and LLM researcher working on language agents, agentic RAG systems, multimodal and self-evolving agents, digital mental health, and modeling human behavior with generative agents. My work spans end-to-end AI microservice development, agent workflows, retrieval systems, backend services, and research on human-centered AI, human-agent interaction, and psychological applications of LLMs.

work.name: IntRest
work.summary: End-to-end ownership of an AI microservice for food analysis, covering agentic system design, retrieval, backend architecture, and production integration.
highlights: Own the end-to-end AI microservice for food analysis: refactored the full codebase, built an agentic RAG system over food and ingredient data for accurate and efficient analysis, and lead the software layer from requirements and backend design to API endpoints and production integration.

work.name: Lucid Axon
work.summary: Document-AI and retrieval systems for ESG, legal, and compliance workflows.
highlights: Built document-AI components for ESG workflows, including a local DeepSeek OCR pipeline and a hierarchical ingestion/retrieval microservice for high-stakes legal and compliance documents.

work.name: Adan AI
work.summary: Production-oriented LLM applications, agentic customer-service systems, Persian document RAG pipelines, FAQ-bot automation, and reusable LangGraph infrastructure.
highlights: Led architecture and delivery of an agentic customer-service chatbot for a national bank: translated PM requirements into user stories; designed a ReAct/Reflexion workflow with more than 15 tool steps; implemented and reviewed LangGraph and OpenAI modules; defined and tracked evaluation metrics for production.

Built an end-to-end PDF-to-chunking pipeline for Persian documents, including table/chart-aware parsing and entity extraction; reduced processing cost by 50% and improved retrieval accuracy by 8% on a human-annotated RAG evaluation set.

Created an automatic FAQ-bot generator that ingests Excel FAQs, cleans and synthesizes data from seed examples, and deploys a ready-to-use chatbot, cutting onboarding time from days to less than one hour with no manual coding.

Engineered reusable agent-infrastructure modules for session-level user-token management, conversation summarization, entity enrichment, and metadata handling; these modules were adopted across LangGraph projects, eliminating duplicate code and accelerating new-bot delivery.

projects.name: Text-to-Insight Data Analyst Agent (Text2SQL & Data Visualization)
projects.description: LLMs course final project; team of 3.
projects.summary: End-to-end agent converting natural-language questions into SQL over a curated SQLite database from the BIRD dataset, then auto-generating Python analysis code for tables/plots and a written report.
highlights: Built a natural-language-to-SQL workflow over a curated SQLite database.
Generated Python analysis code for tabular analysis and visualization.
Produced written analytical reports from query results.
Included an LLM-as-judge framework to evaluate component quality and end-to-end answers, including report accuracy and SQL exact match.
